description: Get status and result for an asynchronous job started by async tools such as import_scrivener_sync_async, merge_scrivener_project_beta, or enrich_scene_characters_batch. Use this to poll job progress after receiving a job_id. Common next step: if status is still running, call this tool again; if status is completed inspect result, and if status is failed or cancelled inspect job/result diagnostics.

include_result.description: If true (default), includes completed result payload when available.

job_id.description: Job ID returned by an async start tool.

name: get_async_job_status
